title: Validate `provider_meta` for duplicate blocks
body:
https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform/pull/39153 introduced a small regression with `provider_meta` validation. We  decoupled resolving provider meta types from configuration parsing in that PR. During configuration parsing we can only check for duplicate `provider_meta` blocks with the same label. This PR adds back the validation for `provider_meta` blocks with different labels that resolve to same local provider.

## Related Code
https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform/blob/7dd5b3394b4487afc235b86a1a588e5c8fef8e7e/internal/configs/config.go#L639-L645

https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform/blob/7dd5b3394b4487afc235b86a1a588e5c8fef8e7e/internal/configs/module.go#L349-L362

## UX 
**1.16.1**
```
~/tmp/provider-meta-validation via 💠 default  ~ 1s
❯ ~/Downloads/terraform_1.16.1_darwin_arm64/terraform init
Initializing the backend...

╷
│ Error: Terraform encountered problems during initialisation, including problems
│ with the configuration, described below.
│
│ The Terraform configuration must be valid before initialization so that
│ Terraform can determine which modules and providers need to be installed.
│
│
╵
╷
│ Error: Duplicate provider_meta block
│
│   on main.tf line 14, in terraform:
│   14:   provider_meta "second" {
│
│ A provider_meta block for provider "first" was already declared at main.tf:11,3-24. Providers may only have one provider_meta block per module.
╵
╷
│ Error: Duplicate provider_meta block
│
│   on main.tf line 14, in terraform:
│   14:   provider_meta "second" {
│
│ A provider_meta block for provider "first" was already declared at main.tf:11,3-24. Providers may only have one provider_meta block per module.
```

**1.17.0-beta1**
```
~/tmp/provider-meta-validation via 💠 default  ~ 16s
❯ ~/Downloads/terraform_1.17.0-beta1_darwin_arm64/terraform init
Initializing the backend...

Initializing provider plugins...
- Finding latest version of acme/test...
╷
│ Warning: Duplicate required provider
│
│   on main.tf line 6, in terraform:
│    6:     second = {
│    7:       source = "acme/test"
│    8:     }
│
│ Provider acme/test with the local name "second" was previously required as "first". A provider can only be required once within required_providers.
╵
╷
│ Error: Failed to query available provider packages
│
│ Could not retrieve the list of available versions for provider acme/test: provider registry registry.terraform.io does not have a provider named registry.terraform.io/acme/test
│
│ All modules should specify their required_providers so that external consumers will get the correct providers when using a module. To see which modules are currently depending on
│ acme/test, run the following command:
│     terraform providers
╵
```

**This PR**
```
~/tmp/provider-meta-validation via 💠 default  ~ 1s
❯ t init
Initializing the backend...

╷
│ Error: Terraform encountered problems during initialisation, including problems
│ with the configuration, described below.
│
│ The Terraform configuration must be valid before initialization so that
│ Terraform can determine which modules and providers need to be installed.
│
│
╵
╷
│ Error: Duplicate provider_meta block
│
│   on main.tf line 14, in terraform:
│   14:   provider_meta "second" {
│
│ A provider_meta block for provider "first" was already declared at main.tf:11,3-24. Providers may only have one provider_meta block per module.
╵
```
